subject: Mercer Health — marketplace billing switchover and renewal coordination
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Melanie Ortiz <melanie@mercerhealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 8 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Mercer Health — marketplace billing switchover and renewal coordination

Hi Melanie,

Thanks again for the conversation yesterday. Mercer Health's renewal is coming up in July and I wanted to outline a low-friction path to move your licensing to the Azure Marketplace before renewal so all future invoices flow through Microsoft and you can take advantage of consolidated billing and potential co-sell incentives.

Why this helps Mercer (short):
- One consolidated invoice for cloud & Redwood usage (reduces AP reconciliation effort)
- Preserves current net pricing we agreed to (we can reflect the same list/net terms in the marketplace amendment)
- Enables co-sell eligibility with Azure sales motions and increases potential cloud credits

What I need from you to kick this off:
1) Procurement contact (name + email) or confirmation you want me to loop in procurement@mercerhealth.com
2) Any internal PO/contract flow (do you require a PO before DocuSign or will you accept a marketplace invoice?)
3) A quick 2–3 week cutover window that aligns with your renewal (we can be flexible)

I attached a short "Conversion Playbook" that outlines the steps and timeline, and I can send a draft marketplace amendment for legal review once you confirm the procurement channel.

If it helps, I can also schedule a 30-min call with our finance ops lead (Karthik) and your procurement person to walk through the SAP/Ariba flow.

Next best step: reply with your procurement contact and preferred PO timing and I’ll route the amendment.

Thanks,

--
Soojin Lee
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0196
Redwood Inference
Attachment: Redwood_Marketplace_Conversion_Playbook.pdf

Hi Soojin,

Appreciate the note and the playbook — looks promising. A few quick questions from procurement/finance side:

1) Will pricing be identical on the marketplace? We need confirmation that our net effective price is preserved (line item and any existing credits).
2) Our AP runs on SAP Ariba; procurement prefers to issue a PO before countersigning amendments. Is that acceptable?
3) Any changes to invoicing frequency (monthly vs quarterly)?

My procurement contact is listed below — I’ve CC’d the team on process questions.

Melanie Ortiz

melanie@mercerhealth.com | +1 (617) 555-6622

Hi Melanie — thanks, and great questions. Short answers below and details after.

1) Pricing: we will preserve the net pricing in the marketplace amendment. The draft reflects the same effective rates and any agreed credits; I’ll attach the draft for your legal/procurement to validate.
2) PO process: that’s fine — we can accept a PO from Mercer before countersignature. Our legal team will include a clause allowing a final marketplace invoice after listing; your PO number can be referenced in the amendment.
3) Invoicing frequency: we can keep monthly invoicing; marketplace invoices will show aggregated charges by month.

Next steps I propose:
- I’ve attached the first-pass marketplace amendment for your review (Redwood_Marketplace_Amendment_draft.pdf).
- If procurement prefers, we’ll accept a PO prior to execution — please send Mercer_PO_Process.docx back with any internal routing notes.
- Once you confirm, I’ll initiate a DocuSign route and loop in our finance ops for the final invoice mapping.

For transparency, HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/RDW-3491. DocuSign link will be shared once we align on PO timing.

Would you be available for a 20-min call tomorrow to walk procurement through the amendment? I’ll bring Karthik (finance ops) and Grace (enterprise success).

Thanks,

--
Soojin Lee
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Attachment: Redwood_Marketplace_Amendment_draft.pdf

Quick internal note / action items before we go live with customer call: 

- Legal: please review the attached amendment and confirm we can accept a PO prior to countersignature and that marketplace invoice mapping is handled by finance. I will open a legal ticket with the amendment attached.
- Finance ops (me & Grace): I’ll prepare the invoice mapping doc and the sample AR line items that the marketplace will generate. Grace, can you draft a one-pager for procurement that explains invoice reconciliation and the PO flow for SAP Ariba?
- AE (Soojin): schedule the 20-min procurement walkthrough with Mercer procurement + Melanie and share DocuSign placeholder URL after we confirm PO path.

We should aim to have legal comments back within 48 hours so we can get a signed amendment and move billing to marketplace before the renewal window.
